# Parser sample files

There is one small sample file per supported format. The parser tests (`tests/parsers/<id>.test.js`) read these files, and you can drop them on the app to try a reader.

**All files are synthetic.** They are sums of Gaussian or tailed peaks with seeded noise, generated by [`tools/make-samples.js`](../../tools/make-samples.js) in the vendor's file layout. None are copied from instruments, vendors or other projects. They are dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0** (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

To regenerate them, run `node tools/make-samples.js`. The output is deterministic, so a clean run should leave `git status` unchanged.

| File | Parser (`src/parsers/`) | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `delimited.csv` | `delimited.js` | Comment line, `Key: value` preamble, `Time (min),Absorbance (mAU)` header; 3 peaks, tallest at 4.80 min |
| `json.json` | `json.js` | Peakly "Traces JSON" export (`schema: {name: 'peakly-traces'}`) with app peaks and `peakRows` (round trip) |
| `xlsx.xlsx` | `xlsx.js` | Minimal OOXML workbook (stored ZIP, inline strings); parsed when SheetJS is loaded |
| `jcamp.jdx` | `jcamp.js` | JCAMP-DX 5.01 `(X++(Y..Y))` in ASDF DIFDUP form with Y-check values, `YFACTOR` |
| `netcdf.cdf` | `netcdf.js` | AIA/ANDI chromatography netCDF-3 (CDF1): `ordered_derivative_values`, 0.5 s sampling, `detector_unit` mAU |
| `mzml.mzML` | `mzml.js` | mzML 1.1 with TIC and BPC chromatograms; 64-bit time in seconds, 32-bit intensities, uncompressed |
| `agilent-ch.ch` | `agilent-ch.js` | ChemStation type 130 binary (delta encoded), `DAD1 A, Sig=273,4` |
| `agilent-text.csv` | `agilent-text.js` | ChemStation CSV export: UTF-16LE with BOM, no header |
| `chromeleon.txt` | `chromeleon.js` | Chromeleon ASCII: info blocks, `Chromatogram Data:` table with `Step (s)` and `n.a.` |
| `shimadzu.txt` | `shimadzu.js` | LabSolutions ASCII: `[Header]`, `[LC Chromatogram(Detector A-Ch1)]` with `Intensity Multiplier`, `[Peak Table]` |
| `waters-arw.arw` | `waters-arw.js` | Empower `.arw`: quoted key/value header lines, 2-column data in AU |
| `unicorn.asc` | `unicorn.js` | UNICORN curve export: UV/Cond/Conc B/Fractions pairs, x in mL |
| `biorad.csv` | `biorad.js` | ChromLab/NGC CSV: report lines, Volume (ml) + UV + Conductivity + GP (%B) |
| `unsupported.raw` | `unsupported.js` | Thermo-style `01 A1` magic only; checks the "export as mzML/text" advice |
| `chromatopy_FID_output.json` | `chromatopy.js` | chromatoPy `FID_output.json`: 2 samples, fitted peaks with ensemble areas, Python `NaN` for a missing peak |
| `chromatopy_hplc.csv` | `chromatopy.js` | chromatoPy `hplc_to_csv` layout: `RT (min)` + ion (m/z) columns |
| `mocca2.json` | `mocca2.js` | MOCCA2 `MoccaDataset.to_dict()`: 11-wavelength DAD data, one deconvolved peak (2 named compounds) + one plain peak |
